description: This file contains JUnit tests for the SearchSource class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies the behavior of stream search functionalities, including handling of empty streams, partial dissync situations, cursor restarts, and error cases, using Akka Streams testkit and mocks.

classes.name: SearchSourceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing SearchSource component in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, Materializer, and test probes before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: emptyStream
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the search stream is empty.

methods.name: clientError
methods.description: Tests behavior when a client error occurs.

methods.name: nonemptyStreamWithPartialDissync
methods.description: Tests handling of a partially out-of-sync stream with some inaccessible things.

methods.name: resumeAtStart
methods.description: Verifies stream resumption from a stored cursor position.

methods.name: cursorDeleted
methods.description: Tests stream recovery after cursor deletion or not found error.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description:
Helper method to create a Thing instance
 for testing.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Helper method to create RetrieveThingResponse objects.

methods.name: retrieveThing
methods.description: Helper method to create RetrieveThing requests.

methods.name: materializeSourceProbe
methods.description: Creates a test source probe and source ref for stream testing.

methods.name: streamThings
methods.description: Helper method to create StreamThings request objects.

methods.name: startTestSearchSource
methods.description: Sets up and runs the SearchSource for testing with specific parameters.
